anchors.anchor: “I thought at first of taking you somewhere more exciting.
“Are you ready?” He sounds eager and a bit nervous.
When I open my eyes, I realize it’s dark outside.
“I’m ready,” I confirm, grabbing my purse.
“You don’t mean the Crescent City Hotel, do you?”
I nip at the tip of his nose.
I’m not sure why Daniel doesn’t see this.
So I guess I’m going along with this after all.
